shortTitle: Implications of Care Cascade Definitions in Diabetes Care
longTitle: Comparing approaches for deriving diabetes care cascades to inform policy: a cross-sectional analysis using national data from 88 countries
summary: Felix Teufel led this analysis to show how different definitions of diabetes care cascades based on self-reported diagnosis and self-reported treatment may result in very different policy priorities. We identified a group of individuals with self-reported diagnosis but no self-reported treatment (Group E in the paper), whose relative proportion in the population unduly influences the downstream results.
citation: Teufel F., et.al. Comparing approaches for deriving diabetes care cascades to inform policy: a cross-sectional analysis using national data from 88 countries. Diabetes Care (Forthcoming). 2026. doi:10.2337/dc26-0267
